newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan gasoline retail price unchanged - survey.
newsitem.headline: Japan gasoline retail price unchanged - survey.

text.p: The average price of gasoline at petrol stations throughout Japan was 106 yen per litre as of March 10, unchanged from a month earlier, a research centre said on Monday.

The Oil Information Service Centre said a survey it conducted showed that the retail price of gasoline was unchanged for the fourth consecutive month, even though refiners' have raised their wholesale prices to reflect a weaker yen against the dollar.
A price war among gasoline stations has stopped retailers from raising prices.
The average national retail price of gas oil was 83 yen per per litre as of March 10, also unchanged for the fourth successive month.
The retail price of kerosene was 905 yen per 18 kilolitres, up two yen from the previous month.
